articles.title: Tokenization has become a strategic priority for 84% of financial firms
articles.snippet: A Broadridge survey found Wall Street is accelerating tokenization efforts while betting on hybrid markets where digital and traditional assets coexist.

articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin returns to $63,000 as Nasdaq trims large early loss
articles.snippet: A deepening global selloff in chipmakers dragged risk assets lower, pulling bitcoin back from the $65,000 level it reached on this week's soft inflation print.

articles.title: Risk-off wave drags bitcoin below $63,000 as AI selloff spreads from stocks to crypto
articles.snippet: Crypto fell as AI stock fatigue and U.S.-Iran tensions weighed on sentiment, though a technical measure hints at oversold conditions heading into the weekend.

articles.title: $1.9 trillion asset manager T. Rowe Price bets on active management with first multi-token crypto ETF
articles.snippet: T. Rowe Price launched what it says is the industry's first actively managed multi-token spot crypto ETF, offering diversified exposure to digital assets.

articles.title: FTX to distribute $900M to creditors in fifth payment round
articles.snippet: The FTX Recovery Trust and company have distributed about $10 billion since the exchange filed for bankruptcy in November 2022, leaving users cut off from their funds.
